summary: New AWS customers receive USD $100 in Free Tier credits after creating an account, on either the Free or Paid account plan, and can earn up to USD $100 more by completing activities in the Explore AWS widget on the Console Home dashboard ($20 each: launch an EC2 instance, use a foundation model in the Amazon Bedrock playground, set up an AWS Budgets cost budget, build a Lambda web app, create an RDS database, create a DynamoDB table). The Free account plan costs nothing for up to six months and ends after six months or when credits are fully used, whichever comes first; free plans cannot use certain services that would rapidly consume the credit. Activity credits cannot be earned after activating advanced features, joining AWS Organizations, or setting up a Control Tower landing zone.
claim_steps: Go to aws.amazon.com/free and choose Create free account.
Complete sign-up and choose the Free account plan or Paid account plan; $100 in credits is applied.
Open the Explore AWS widget on the AWS Console Home dashboard and complete activities (e.g. use a model in the Amazon Bedrock playground) to earn $20 each, up to $100.

social_proof.title: AWS Free Tier
social_proof.text: When you create a new AWS Free Tier account, you get $100 in credits immediately. As you explore key services, you can earn up to $100 more. The account closes on its own 6 months after you open it or when your credits run out, whichever comes first.

social_proof.title: Explore AWS services with AWS Free Tier - AWS Billing
social_proof.text: If you are new to AWS, you receive USD $100 in credits after you create an account, regardless of your account plan. You can also earn up to an additional USD $100 in credits by completing activities.

social_proof.title: Earning additional credits - AWS Billing
social_proof.text: Each activity earns USD $20 in credits, and you can choose the activities that best fit your use case. The maximum you can earn from activities is USD $100. [Activities include] Use a foundational model in the Amazon Bedrock playground.
